# go-modern-strings-cut-prefix-suffix

**Since:** Go 1.20

## Summary

Use strings.CutPrefix or strings.CutSuffix when you need both the trimmed result and whether it matched.

## Details

CutPrefix and CutSuffix combine the match check and trimming operation.
They avoid writing HasPrefix or HasSuffix followed by a second operation that repeats the same condition.

## Examples

### Before

```go
if strings.HasPrefix(s, "pre:") {
  rest := strings.TrimPrefix(s, "pre:")
  use(rest)
}
```

### After

```go
if rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(s, "pre:"); ok {
  use(rest)
}
```
